title: Correct Sepharose as an exact agarose alias while preserving provisional role status
body:
Agarose.yaml retains Sepharose as an exact synonym. ChEBI:2511 marks it as related, and the Cytiva manual describes a resin family with defined agarose matrices and supplied suspensions; the CL variants are cross-linked, so it would also be wrong to say every Sepharose product is cross-linked. Those product scopes do not establish universal exact identity with bulk agarose.

Exact reviewed scope:
- Finding `MEDIA-SCI-04`; stable key `w04-independent-MEDIA-SCI-04`; immutable peer review `20261108T070033Z-w04-successor-science-v1`.
- `I1201-MEDIA-P-agarose`; owner `data/ingredients/mapped/Agarose.yaml`; before `f5c974c40d6d5f05f49d051ba5852e4fbfd41b23d3bbc5a29e62aa31ced36c3d`; proposed SHA256 `5b4a48e113802e2603a4e73053f32abde2fba47abfaaf38dc518bfe0853e1817`.
  [Exact published proposal](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/548e7bdd0ce2a68b3ae0df6ad7a6150a4e5c9bb9/reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-04/successors/issue-1201-v1/proposals/media/Agarose.yaml).

Retain the supported electrophoresis-grade agarose annotation. Preserve the Sepharose text with a justified nonresolving product relationship/rejected exact-identity disposition; merely changing to RELATED_SYNONYM does not guarantee nonresolution under the current policy. Do not invent one Sepharose identity for every product. The existing CARBON_SOURCE entry is explicitly COMPUTATIONAL_PREDICTION: retain its provisional, unapproved status, or separately assess it under #718. This issue does not authorize its deletion simply because the reviewed source uses agarose as a solidifier, and grants no role approval.

Evidence:

- [Primary/ontology source](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/api/ontologies/chebi/terms?iri=http%3A%2F%2Fpurl.obolibrary.org%2Fobo%2FCHEBI_2511); capture SHA256 `1d39dec03e0eb030208260e777726573ba4af685d3f429ec737ac63a8742f8f8`; obo_synonym Sepharose scope=hasRelatedSynonym; polymer definition/structure
- [Primary/ontology source](https://cdn.cytivalifesciences.com/api/public/content/digi-11534-pdf); capture SHA256 `660409b813c50b02b4219f7f3cc6f97ee02a687bf578a6156b20f1ca2a5e2c40`; Cytiva71709800AF pp3-5 family/matrix/supplied form

Deduplication: Fresh all-state Sepharose search returned no exact tracker. #917 concerns skill documentation; #718 is relevant only to the separate unapproved role boundary.

Review context: W04 published head `548e7bdd0ce2a68b3ae0df6ad7a6150a4e5c9bb9`, frozen campaign base `e000d66dd26ab053e9b17ce7bf8d3c873c3dde99`. Main as observed at `0dac278466699129a083343a921c2e0ca18a9ab4` has the same eighteen affected inherited-owner blobs as the frozen baseline; this is not a report of already-applied campaign curation. The full independent assembly covers 188 source cases and 115 proposals and remains `needs_curation`. Original peer review and evidence are immutable. Agent-authored new mapping evidence must satisfy #1226 without relabeling historical human evidence. The fix must use existing native guarded proposal validation and independent re-review; it grants no maintained-owner or export approval and requires no new gate, threshold, or synonym-selection rule.
